shared_elements: relief carving of figural subject matter
human hand with splayed fingers rendered in low relief
curled/tightly patterned hair or fur rendered as rows of small units
justification: Both are figural reliefs and both include a human hand with splayed fingers and dense rows of small curl-like units for hair/fur, and both present their subject essentially in profile, which gives a loose stylistic kinship. But A shows what appear to be crouching quadruped-like bodies in a horizontal band beside an isolated flat hand, while B shows a single large bust of a bearded, capped human head with earring, necklace and patterned garment; the specific subjects, their relationships and their placement on the surface are quite different.
